name: nurevo/webmcp-canary-phpcs
description: Coding-standards tooling for the Nurevo AEO plugin. Dev-only; nothing here ships.

extra.comment: PHPCompatibility 10 (alpha) is used because 9.3.5, the last stable release, predates PHP 8 and cannot flag 8.x-only syntax or functions, which is the point of testVersion 7.4-. Versions are exact so CI is reproducible without a lock file (packagist was unreachable when this was written).
